name: com.qamel.unity
description: QA tools for Unity. Includes session capture: continuous gameplay and game state recording with an in-game bug report hotkey, keeping a rolling buffer of frames, logs and input with minimal performance impact; reports are bundled in memory and uploaded to Qamel.

samples.description: Measures Qamel Capture frame-time overhead (baseline vs rolling buffer vs continuous streaming) across capture resolutions and rates.
